dct_description_sm: CTD profiles were conducted to examine the oceanography of Milne Fiord from the glacier grounding line to the open ocean. These observations were collected to examine variability in water properties along and across the fiord, to infer the position and height of topographic sills, to look for deep water renewal events and to examine the amount of melt water from the glacier, ice shelf or watershed.
dct_title_s: Milne Fiord CTD (Conductivity, Temperature, Depth) profiles
